text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are hereby appropriated, out of
any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be at the disposal of the Director of Public
Works for the purposes mentioned hereunder, after allotment by the Secretary of Commerce and
Communications and approval by a Joint Committee to be appointed by the Senate or the President thereof
and the House of Representatives or the Steering Committee, and presided over by the presiding officers of
both Houses of the Legislature: Provided, That the appropriations made in paragraphs (b), (g), (h), (i), (k), (l),
(m), (o), and (u) of this Act, as hereinafter set forth in detail, shall be made available immediately by the
Director of Public Works:
CONSTRUCTION, COMPLETION, AND MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC BUILDINGS AND OTHER
UNCLASSIFIED PROJECTS
For the maintenance, alteration, improvement, and repair of public buildings, including adjacent lands
belonging to the same
Provided, That of this sum, not to exceed P5,000 shall be set aside for the purchase and installation of the
additional equipment required for the completion of the laundry at the Culiou Leper Colony and for the
payment of the regular surcharge of the Bureau of Public Works.
For the continuation of the construction of the Iloilo Normal School
110,000.00

CONSTRUCTION AND MAINTENANCE OF ROADS AND BRIDGES
For the maintenance and improvement of the Benguet and Naguilian Roads and the road from Camp One to

120,000.00
For the construction, maintenance, reconstruction, and improvement of trails, roads, and bridges in such

guarantee by continuing annual appropriations the establishment of such a system of maintenance as may be
necessary in the judgment of the Director of Public Works on all trails, roads, and bridges now constructed or
which may be constructed in the future

may be declared as such by the Director of Public Works; to be allotted in proportion to the number of cedulas
sold in each province in the year nineteen hundred and twenty-three

For the preliminary investigation and survey of irrigation and water supply systems, hydraulic power
development and river control projects; for the survey of streams; and for the operation, maintenance, and
repair of irrigation systems
170,000.00

For the investigation of applications for the use of water for irrigation, water supply, and power systems; and
for the adjudication of the rights to streams designated by the Secretary of Commerce and Communications
40,000.00
-----------------
Total available for the maintenance and investigation of irrigation systems

CONSTRUCTION OF ARTESIAN WELLS AND WATERWORKS
For drilling of artesian wells by the Bureau of Public Works, including the purchase of necessary equipment,
and for the investigation and construction of Insular, provincial, and municipal waterworks, whenever, in
cases of provincial and municipal projects, the provinces and municipalities concerned shall adopt resolutions
for the appropriation of funds covering the cost of one-third of the work
600,000.00
Provided, That the funds appropriated by provinces and municipalities to cover the cost of one-third of the
work shall be paid into the Insular Treasury when the Director of Public Works shall have paid the cost
thereof: Provided further, That any municipality or province which by virtue of the provisions of this Act shall
incur the expense of an artesian well resulting in a failure, shall have the amounts expended returned to it:
Provided, further, That the amount allotted out of this appropriation to a municipality or province as Insular
aid shall in no case exceed at one time the sum of twenty-five thousand pesos: Provided, finally, That the
Director of Public Works shall forthwith order artesian wells constructed in municipalities which have already
made appropriations for said purpose and in municipalities in whose budget for nineteen hundred and
twenty-four appropriations are made for the construction of artesian wells.
Total available for the construction of artesian wells and waterworks
------------------
600,000.00
PORT AND RIVER IMPROVEMENTS
For the maintenance, construction, reconstruction, completion, and improvement of piers, retaining walls, and
wharves, and dredging in Manila and in the special provinces
220,000.00
For the completion and maintenance of landing places, wharves, dikes, and works necessary for the regulation
of rivers and protection of shores; the purchase, maintenance, and repair of equipment for port works, and
dredging of harbors in the various districts of the Archipelago, including the construction of a retaining wall in
the river which causes inundations in the municipality of La Paz, Province of Iloilo
1,135,000.00
Provided, That subject to the approval of the Secretary of Commerce and Communications and with such
security as he may require, material derived from dredging may be used for filling in private property at the
request of any landowner, upon the condition that the cost thereof shall be paid by the owner of the land in
annual installments not to extend over more than five years: And provided, further, That in case of marine
accidents the damages caused by any port equipment may be paid subject to like approval of the Secretary of

Commerce and Communications. The total of such payments out of funds appropriated by this subsection
shall not exceed ten thousand pesos.
Total available for port and river improvements
---------------
1,355,000.00
RECONSTRUCTION, MAINTENANCE, AND CONSTRUCTION OF TELEGRAPH AND TELEPHONE
LINES, CABLES, AND RADIOS

Province of Mindoro

150,000.00
Grand total of the appropriations made in this Act-Seven million one hundred and ninety thousand pesos
7,190,000.00

All balances of the several appropriations made by this Act the destination of which has not yet
been detemined by the proper authority on June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and twenty-four, and all balances
of appropriations which remain unexpended on June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and twenty-five, shall revert
to the unappropriated funds in the Insular Treasury, and thereafter shall not be available for expenditure
except upon appropriation by the Legislature.

The Secretary of Commerce and Communications, with the approval of the Joint Committee to
be appointed by the Senate or the President thereof and the House of Representatives or the Steering
Committee, may, for the purposes of allotment, transfer unexpended portions of any item of appropriation

under this Act to any other item hereunder.

In the construction of school houses for which appropriations are made in this Act, mixed
materials shall be used when the funds provided for this purpose amount to less than five thousand pesos.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 9, 1924, with the exception of items (c), (d), (e), (j), (k), (I), (m), (n), and (y), which have
been vetoed.
